0.

FOREWORD

O-1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution

on 9 June 1978, after the draft finalized by the Industrial Safety Aclvisory Committee had been approved by the Executive Committee.

0.2 This standard is intended to guide workers and those in charge of their safety in industrial operations in selecting such protective equipment for hands and arms as will give the required protection against hazards likely to be encountered. 0.3 This standard is one of a series of Indian Standards on industrial safety equipment for protection of arms and hands. Other standards published so far in the series are given on page 8.

1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard describes the various types of safety equipment for protection of arms and hands and provides guidance on the protection afforded against specific hazards by different types of protective equipment. 2. CLASSIFICATION TION OF ARMS OF HAZARDS AND HANDS RELATED TO PROTEC-

2.1 Hazards against which arms and hands protection are given in Table 1. 3. TYl?YPE;s OF PROTEGTIVE EQUIPMENT
